import json, random, subprocess, sys, os, time, tempfile, resource

MAIN = "/app/submission/main.py"

def limited():
    resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS, (512 * 1024 * 1024,) * 2)

def canon(o):
    return len(json.dumps(o, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=True).encode("ascii"))

def peak_rss(pr):
    return pr  # filled later

d = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir="/workspace/tmp")

# --- A) memory/heap stress: 1e6 undecided packets, distinct times, 2048 rules
rnd = random.Random(5)
rules = []
for i in range(2048):
    rr = []
    for _ in range(8):
        lo = rnd.randint(-2048, 1000); hi = min(2048, lo + rnd.randint(0, 900))
        rr.append([lo, hi])
    rules.append({"id": i, "class": i % 65536, "priority": 0, "ranges": rr})
cfg = {"version":1,"idle_timeout":10**9,"packet_limit":10**9,"prefix_width":8,"rules":rules,
       "fallback":{"feature":0,"threshold":0,"le":{"class":8},"gt":{"class":9}}}
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", MAIN, "compile"], input=json.dumps(cfg).encode(), stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
prog = os.path.join(d, "a.json"); open(prog,"wb").write(p.stdout)
print("program canonical size:", canon(json.loads(p.stdout)), "bytes")
pr = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-I", MAIN, "stream", prog], stdin=subprocess.PIPE,
                      stdout=subprocess.PIPE, cwd=d, preexec_fn=limited)
pr.stdin.write(b'{"op":"open","flow":1,"time":0}\n'); pr.stdin.flush(); pr.stdout.readline()
t0=time.time()
for blk in range(977):
    pk=[{"flow":1,"time":blk*1024+i,"source":i%2,"length":1+(i*7919)%2048} for i in range(1024)]
    pr.stdin.write(json.dumps({"op":"chunk","packets":pk}).encode()+b"\n"); pr.stdin.flush(); pr.stdout.readline()
print("1e6 pkt time", round(time.time()-t0,1))
t0=time.time()
pr.stdin.write(b'{"op":"checkpoint"}\n'); pr.stdin.flush()
line = pr.stdout.readline(); pr.stdin.close(); pr.wait()
cp = json.loads(line)["checkpoint"]
print("checkpoint time", round(time.time()-t0,2), "canonical VALUE size", canon(cp), "limit", 512+8192*1)
print("heap len in cp:", len(cp["h"]), "flows:", len(cp["f"]))

# --- B) 100000 match records
rules2 = [{"id": i, "class": 1, "priority": i, "ranges": [[-2048,2048]]} for i in range(100)]
cfg2 = {"version":1,"idle_timeout":10**9,"packet_limit":10**9,"prefix_width":1,"rules":rules2,
        "fallback":{"class":3}}
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", MAIN, "compile"], input=json.dumps(cfg2).encode(), stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
prog = os.path.join(d, "b.json"); open(prog,"wb").write(p.stdout)
pr = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-I", MAIN, "stream", prog], stdin=subprocess.PIPE,
                      stdout=subprocess.PIPE, cwd=d, preexec_fn=limited)
pr.stdin.write(b'{"op":"open","flow":1,"time":0}\n'); pr.stdin.flush(); pr.stdout.readline()
tot=0; t0=time.time(); mx=0
for blk in range(1000):
    pr.stdin.write(json.dumps({"op":"chunk","packets":[{"flow":1,"time":blk,"source":0,"length":7}]}).encode()+b"\n")
    pr.stdin.flush(); line=pr.stdout.readline(); mx=max(mx,len(line))
    tot += len(json.loads(line)["events"])
pr.stdin.close(); rc=pr.wait()
print("matches emitted:", tot, "time", round(time.time()-t0,1), "max line", mx, "rc", rc)

# --- C) checkpoint size with 4096 flows (largest per-flow state: W=32 prefix+tail)
rules3 = [{"id": 1, "class": 1, "priority": 1, "ranges": [[-2048,2048]]*32} for _ in range(1)]
cfg3 = {"version":1,"idle_timeout":10**9,"packet_limit":10**9,"prefix_width":32,"rules":rules3,
        "fallback":{"class":3}}
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", MAIN, "compile"], input=json.dumps(cfg3).encode(), stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
prog = os.path.join(d, "c.json"); open(prog,"wb").write(p.stdout)
pr = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-I", MAIN, "stream", prog], stdin=subprocess.PIPE,
                      stdout=subprocess.PIPE, cwd=d, preexec_fn=limited)
reqs=[{"op":"open","flow":i,"time":0} for i in range(4096)]
reqs.append({"op":"chunk","packets":[{"flow":i,"time":0,"source":i%2,"length":1+(i%2047)} for i in range(4096)]})
reqs.append({"op":"checkpoint"})
for r in reqs:
    pr.stdin.write(json.dumps(r).encode()+b"\n"); pr.stdin.flush()
    line=pr.stdout.readline()
cp=json.loads(line)["checkpoint"]
pr.stdin.close(); pr.wait()
print("4096-flow checkpoint canonical VALUE:", canon(cp), "limit", 512+8192*4096)
PYEOF
